written: 2026-10-25, window D, before deploy 5 (docs/design/agent_eval.md, item 7). The language set: the requests are three of the 20's (A01, D01 and B03 shapes), each with the App's language set to Malay, Tamil or Chinese in the form, so this file tests the translation the App shows, not new requests; window B may read it. Graded under the current criteria only, reported apart from the 20 and the held-out 9.
default_checks: every scenario also gets agent_eval.DEFAULT_CHECKS, on the English draft
fixed_lines_note: Each language's footer and label as code inserts them, frozen from coolcheck.languages when window B's deploy-5 build is committed and copied here by window D with that commit's hash. Null until then; the runner refuses a live run of this set while any is null (agent_eval.fixed_lines_frozen).
